purpose: Frozen model configuration and pricing record for BM-06. Values here are configured, never fetched at run time; the two pre-execution checks below are re-confirmed immediately before execution and the run does not start if either fails.

model.note: claude-sonnet-5 is the complete identifier for this model; unlike claude-haiku-4-5 (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) it has no dated snapshot form. Appending a date suffix returns 404. The 'snapshot' recorded for a run is therefore this id plus the /v1/models response captured immediately before execution.

snapshot_evidence_required_before_run.status: NOT_CAPTURED — capturing it is a provider request, which is not authorized

provider.url_value: NOT_FROZEN — recorded at freeze time; HTTPS enforced by ProviderConfig.from_env
provider.note: No provider-specific header is sent to any host. Provider neutrality is an M1 acceptance property (M1-S03, test_adapter_neutrality.py) and is not relaxed for the benchmark.

temperature.problem: claude-sonnet-5 rejects non-default sampling parameters with a 400. 0.0 is not the default. Whether the OpenAI-compatible endpoint forwards, remaps, or drops the field is unverified, and verifying it requires a provider request.
temperature.consequence_if_unresolved: every task in all three arms fails, consuming the authorization on 90 rejections
temperature.proposed_resolution: pass temperature=None from the benchmark harness so the field is omitted entirely
temperature.why_not_applied: it is a change to the approved M1 tree; that is a reviewer decision, not one taken during benchmark preparation

runtime_configuration.max_attempts_note: the shipped single-attempt behaviour (DAR-010); BM-06 measures the product as it exists
runtime_configuration.scope: one frozen authorization scope for all 90 tasks (DAR-005)

pricing.verification_method: documentation lookup, not a live provider request

worst_case_reservation.method: riftagent.records.reserve_cost at the frozen caps; token_ceiling = chars/3 + 1500
worst_case_reservation.note: This is the ceiling the SpendLedger reserves, not an expected spend. It assumes every prompt fills its context cap and every response fills its output cap.

contingency.rule: The contingency is authorized separately and only if the primary run is invalidated. It is never silently consumed.
contingency.precedent: The M1a verify benchmark had a run invalidated by a harness defect: derive_judge_weakening built its diff with `git diff`, which compares the working tree to the index, so all four judge-weakening cases were malformed and that known-bad class measured nothing.

authorization.historical_note: 27 requests from earlier calibration work, averaging about $0.0025 each against a per-task worst case of $0.0873 to $0.1269. Unrelated to BM-06.
